claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Cummins 之後的 10-Q／10-K／新聞稿寫出資料中心燃氣機組訂單取消、延後超過一年，或停止供應這一類機組；或買方的一手寫出改用別家機組取代它。核查頻率：每季（Cummins 季報）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence，重讀 tech:gas_reciprocating_genset 供給側（本層讀圖寫成後）。
claims.statement: Supplier's press release (Cummins, 2026-06-16): agreement with Circe Energy to provide high-horsepower natural gas generator sets (HSK78 C2000N6CD and QSK60 C1400N6 platforms) as the primary, behind-the-meter power source for Circe's AI HPC data center campuses in Texas, deliveries 2026–2030; Cummins provides the generation equipment, Circe and its engineer-of-record own the system design. Supplier self-report naming the customer; no MW or contract value disclosed.

source_doc.permission_basis: Cummins 公開新聞稿（Business Wire 發布、Nasdaq.com 轉載）；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。published_at 取網址與新聞稿日期 2026-06-16。
source_doc.title: Cummins Inc. 新聞稿（Business Wire，2026-06-16；Nasdaq 轉載）：Cummins Natural Gas Generators to Power Large Scale Data Centers in West Texas——為 Circe Energy 的 AI HPC 資料中心供天然氣發電機組作表後主電源，2026–2030 交貨

sources.quote: Cummins Inc. announced an agreement with Circe Energy to provide a series of high-powered, high-efficiency natural gas generator sets to support a scalable, behind-the-meter, prime power microgrid solution for their High-Performance Computing (HPC) data center located in Texas
Deliveries are scheduled from 2026 through 2030 and will include Cummins’ HSK78 (C2000N6CD) and QSK60 (C1400N6) generator set platforms.

The power system will support Circe’s behind-the-meter power need for their AI HPC data center campuses, including its West Texas campus development, by utilizing Cummins’ HSK78 (C2000N6CD) and QSK60 (C1400N6) high-horsepower natural gas generator sets as the primary power source - without reliability on the grid.

sources.locator: Supporting Circe Energy’s West Texas development 段
sources.quote: Cummins is providing the power generation equipment and technical validation support, while Circe and its engineer-of-record retain responsibility for final system design and implementation.
